title: Tasty Edibles
body:
this mod was made for a streamer named [Gween](https://www.twitch.tv/gweenteakitsune)

this is made to add a few fun and wacky food items, and recipies.
so far there is the baguette, Tasty Stick, and Mercury Protien bar,
along with the Food Reagent, and the Reagent Dough.
there are new crafting recipies for everything.
